purpose: New live-WebMCP baseline -> development-only skill learning -> complete final evaluation and narrated showcase

perTaskBudget.secondAttempt: Only after failed first attempt; same session receives fresh-turn feedback and board reset. Budget exhaustion counts as a failed attempt. Infrastructure failures are reported separately.

improvement.feedback: Only duck-01 through duck-04 development failures from this new live protocol; no held-out boards, results, saved solutions or repository
improvement.selection: Evaluate each revision on all four development puzzles. Stop if all four solve; otherwise select best development score, earliest candidate on a tie. No selection using held-out performance.
improvement.final: Freeze selected candidate before one complete eight-task evaluation. No further revision using final results.

scoring: Task solved only when a model-submitted plan produces won:true on the actual website and matches canonical replay; report final-answer score separately if missing/different. All attempts retained.
comparability: Same eight inputs as historical benchmark, but new transport and instructions; compare fresh baseline to fresh candidate only. Four held-out arrangements share familiar terrain; no unseen-map claim.
